$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the services pack composed with a landscaper content seed and a moss-green brand over the sitework register. Everything else — pages, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Landscaping & hardscaping
description: A landscaping company site: design-build services with honest starting prices, draggable before/after yard transformations, a live open/closed badge with click-to-call, testimonials, credentials, and a quote-request form — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so this appointments seed replaces the base pack's at compose and mirrors THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twin) — the composed template's booking widget and Manage calendar open on this trade's own provider, not the base demo business's.

types.name: Free estimate visit
types.description: A walk of the yard — we measure, listen, and follow up with a written quote.

types.name: Service call
types.description: A scheduled block for cleanups and small jobs — beds, edges, and the punch list, handled.

theme.$comment: Moss green over the sitework register's plan-grid ground — the same trades voice as the category's contractor starter, visibly a different company. Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-skins the pages and the app surfaces together. navigation re-pins the shared servicesShell chrome (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop): the base contractor wears the full-width band, so the landscaping remix takes the centered masthead — the nav-variety audit spreads the nine-template services family across the vocabulary.
